newsitem.title: UK: Scott Pickford to consider Core bid.
newsitem.headline: Scott Pickford to consider Core bid.

text.p: The board of British geoscience and engineering services group Scott Pickford Plc, facing the prospect of two rival bid approaches, was to meet later on Thursday to consider a 6.7 million stg cash bid by U.S.-based analysis group Core Laboratories, a director said.
"The board has not yet met to consider the offer. It should be meeting this afternoon," Director Tony Woodliffe told Reuters by telephone from Scott Pickford's headquarters near London.
During the day, after Core launched its bid at 53 pence per share, Australia's Aerodata holdings Ltd said it was also in talks with Scott Pickford about a possible rival 53p bid.

Aerodata has already built up a 21.5 percent stake in Scott Pickford, and said in its latest statement that if it made any offer for the whole company it would be "subject to a number of preconditions".
When it launched its bid this morning Core Labs said that "the board of Scott Pickford has indicated it intends to recommend the offer".
However, Woodliffe said that the board clearly had a duty to its shareholders to seek the best available deal, adding the firm should make a statement to shareholders after its meeting.
